newsitem.title: USA: Same-sex partners get U.S. university's benefits.
newsitem.headline: Same-sex partners get U.S. university's benefits.

text.p: The University of Maine System's trustees approved a union contract Monday allowing employees to extend benefits to their unmarried or same-sex domestic partners.
The trustees' action will give the partners access to joint coverage under the university's health insurance and allow them to obtain tuition waivers.
Spokesman Kent Price said the system was not trying to send a "political message," and officials believe most of the people now eligible for coverage already have health insurance.
The trustees also voted Monday to seek a state appropriation of more than $300 million in the next two-year budget. The request is an 8 percent increase over the system's current budget.
